notes.title: Beta Update Available
notes.content:
Hi all!

We are working on a technical update -

[b]Stasis will play a smoother, scenes load faster etc. Also optimized for the latest OS. 
The Settings menu has also been updated, access it in the main menu. 
[/b]

Also Includes now Portuguese, Turkish and Hungarian localization!

Gamepad support as well.

Please try it on the Deck!

[h1]HOW TO JOIN[/h1]

[b]
Open Steam, right click on STASIS, Go to Properties and then Betas and enter in code: 

[b]john2024stasis[/b]

Then join "2024stasis - Testing Latest Version"[/b]

ːsteamthumbsupː

[b]Please note that saves ARE NOT compatible with the older game but we have a chapter selection screen now so you can carry on where you left off. [/b]

notes.title: STASIS 2 - BONE TOTEM - AUGUST UPDATE
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/


I'm excited to update you on the progress of STASIS 2 - BONE TOTEM!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/0ebb0ec575691e84af2e1779614ea34d424cffa8.png[/img]

[b]GRAPHICS[/b]

Once we've decided on how the puzzle works, it can take several days to design and illustrate the associated scenes. A puzzle may span several large screens, so all of the rooms have to be planned and detailed concurrently to ensure that the puzzles and interactions will work. We also have to take into account that our puzzle solutions will often involve multiple characters in different areas. STASIS 2 features character switching like the classic adventure game, Day of the Tentacle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/0ba555c3a0c0f1970d1a78f289a72a660d2f1a53.png[/img]

Working with our 3D technician, Mark, who is a 40-year veteran architectural expert, made all the difference in BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION. Structures actually worked as they would in real life (that is until Chris made them look post-apocalyptic). His work on the new STASIS game is fantastic and brings a real-world ‘this could exist?’ edge to the imagery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/569d6d04f4dab65962266622c48190ed9a0dd5fc.gif[/img]

Here are some elements for a yet-to-be-revealed part of the story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/c75788fcd649815d555d8c1bdcf0d63d1f60178e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/10615a640ec576719b0f3d44dad2845525e57843.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/5f0f082dad16753a001fa69938479d43d54e022a.jpg[/img]
Chris is working on the final chapter of Mac and Charlie and so the gameplay is heating up! We have connected most of the game environments together which means you can traverse from one side of the world to the other. Specific puzzle implementation (ie. puzzle code!) will only happen once all screens are completed.

We are trying to find a balance between the familiar world of STASIS and something new and interesting as you can see in these screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/aeae27eff8f9968e20d598de94686428e2a4d55c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/62caedb338cbb26b06df999e8fedeba565bac551.jpg[/img]

[b]GAMEPAD[/b]

Nic has been hard at work implementing native gamepad control - a first for our games - which has not been an easy task, as the scope of reference for gamepad controlled point-and-click adventures is little to none. We considered the ‘virtual cursor’ method that would be easiest in so far as you have a cursor that the player can move with the gamepad. However, this seems like we're losing a great opportunity to explore a different player interface mechanic. Our games have always been a disadvantage as compared to their 3D first-person counterparts, as we need to rely on the players' other senses to form for immersion. The mouse control forms a disconnect whereas the gamepad is a direct control input of the character which could be interesting to explore. We also don't want to isolate our mouse-only players so it is a fine line to balance.

Bearing this in mind, we also have our limitations as essentially a two-man studio. We did it! You can now hot-swap the gamepad and mouse, and STASIS will play as per normal. The systems are also similar so it means less duplicated code to do the same tasks. This may make future console releases quicker and more seamless to our own internal development QA.

[b]MUSIC[/b]

As you know, we pride ourselves on only working with the best. We have a surprise for you, but it shall only be revealed later. It's epic!

[b]WRITING[/b]

Daniel has been hacking away at the text descriptions in the world. Whereas we dedicated a month to write the descriptions in the previous STASIS game, Daniel has now spent the better part of the year writing and crafting each description. He is an immensely talented professional RPG writer and I am sure you will love his prose! 

[b]WISHLIST[/b]

Please wishlist the game if you have not already. This is important for the Steam metrics when we launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/



[b]SOCIALS[/b]

Be sure to follow me on Twitter: https://twitter.com/StasisGame and we keep our Blog updated with minor news here: https://www.thebrotherhoodgames.com/

Oh, and join our Discord - we love to chat!

https://www.thebrotherhoodgames.com/studio/discord

Take care,

[i][b]Chris & Nic[/b][/i]

notes.title: CAYNE ANNOUCEMENT & STEAM SUMMER SALE
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

[b]STEAM SALE[/b]

We are excited to be a part of the Steam Summer Sale! We have added an awesome discount to Deluxe as well as the normal STASIS version. 

We won't discount STASIS again for a while, so grab it now if you haven't already.

[b]MORE ADVENTURE GAMES[/b]

I am happy to announce CAYNE @ www.playcayne.com

VIDEO:

https://youtu.be/GNhIlldrXcA


"Hadley wakes in a facility. She is 9 months pregnant. They want her baby..."

When the dust settled after STASIS, Nic and I knew that the journey wasn't quite over. After spending 5 years with our dear John and the search for his family aboard the Groomlake, we weren't ready to leave the grimy world of Cayne Corporation behind.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/d9a63c213aee1c613a0ccea2a0084f2411057aac.jpg[/img]

So when it came to CAYNE (the additional chapter we'd promised to our Backers) we wanted to do something different. John's story was a small sliver of what the world of STASIS had to offer, and how exciting and rewarding it is to be able to explore a little further... to slice open that seedy underbelly and see what's inside!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/b0ce4a7fa44fdcc1d5b758ff504cbc943beac623.jpg[/img]

CAYNE is a self-contained story. There are threads from STASIS, tethering the two together, while still letting exist apart from one another.


[h1] IT IS FREE![/h1] 

The decision to make CAYNE free to the public was one that we went back and forth on, but we'd love to introduce a taste of STASIS to new audiences. And how better to showcase our new engine framework and what we can do with it?

So look forward to the high quality games that THE BROTHERHOOD plans to produce in the future. 

Alongside the release of CAYNE, we plan on crowd funding an entirely new adventure game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9707603/2e6b512b44728a457639a5d5eb122ad4a8fdd168.jpg[/img]

Please head over to the website for more info and updates.
http://www.playcayne.com




Chat soon,

Chris & Nic

notes.title: ACCOLADES TRAILER & 1.0.8 RELEASED (OS X & WINDOWS)
notes.content:
A special thanks to everybody that has taken the time to write a review on STEAM and in the media. 

Here is our accolades trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b5vNTXmV2ks

We have also released 1.0.8 which we feel is the best version of STASIS to date!

1.0.8.x Includes the following:

1) VSYNC FIX FOR NEWER CARDS
2) GRAPHICS CONFIG TOOL
3) FONT SCALE TOOLS

Thanks for the ongoing support!

-Chris

# FIXED 1.0.7 SAVE GAME BUG

# Fixed bug causing John to walk out of Jupiter passage.

# Removed descriptions when game state changes in hanger room.

# Added additional animation when John interacts with Yuri.
# Increased interactive area when walking into clone vats.
# Fixed bug when coming back into annex.

# Fixed Russian and Polish missing text logs for Akiza Tenschu
# Added text size control driven by Stasis Config Tool.

# Added in loop to push timing events that may skip because of faster cards and refresh rates.

Tram Line Box

Specimen Transport Containers
Pod Control
Retinal Scanner

# Change credits with updated names

# Took out 'mouse reset loop' during Helix sections
# Altered dialog spacing to fit larger text in Specimen Transport pod
# Added reduncancy check to surgery scene to give back control after surgery
# Altered 'MainFontSMALL' as it was causing issues with random numbers appearing (size and colour)
# Changed version number to graphic instead of text
# Old EXIT button wasnt working with old save games - fixed

notes.title: STASIS 1.0.8 RELEASED (OS X & WINDOWS)
notes.content:
1.0.8 Includes many tweaks and small fixes to make STASIS even more streamlined.

We have included a 'graphics config tool' (located in your game folder).

We have also included 3 font sizes for players who want to play in larger screens.

We have (hopefully) fixed the refresh rate issue on newer cards - you no longer have to set this up manually.

The DELUXE version of STASIS now has more content, including ALL DIARY ENTRIES, UNRELEASED DIARY ENTRIES and the SCREENPLAY! We will keep updating it with more goodies.
